author: The MAME team; chimera port by Sergio Martin
_memoryLayoutMiB_note: sbrk, sealed, invisible, plain, mmap. This is room, not use: memory is taken as a machine touches it.

video._comment: The BUFFER CAPACITY. Each machine has its own picture size, so the live size comes from GetVideoWidth/Height every frame, and the shape its screen was shown in from GetDisplayAspectX/Y.
video._vsync_note: Every machine has its own refresh rate; GetVsyncNumerator reports the screen's, in thousandths of a hertz.

audio._comment: MAME's mix of the machine's sound, 48 kHz stereo, all of a frame's at its end.
